title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Begins in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for developing coaching talent within India, ensuring a stronger future for Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations govern a key domestic tournament, directly impacting state teams and player participation across India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has released the regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp prepares India's promising young talent for major continental junior championships, fostering future international stars.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: BAI Adopts 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will impact how junior players compete and develop in India's domestic circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.

title: Pramod Bags Gold, Silver; Sukant Achieves 100-Medal Milestone in Japan
indian_angle: Indian para-badminton stars Pramod Bhagat and Sukant Kadam have achieved significant milestones at an international event in Japan.
summary: Indian para-badminton players Pramod Bhagat secured a gold and a silver medal, while Sukant Kadam completed his career 100-medal haul at a tournament in Japan.
